causebase_summary: Regional Australia Institute Ltd (RAI) is presented on its website as a think tank “devoted to issues concerning regional Australia” and describes its work with phrases the organisation uses such as “Independent | Fact Driven | Future Focused.” Website content and recent posts list recurring activities RAI publishes and convenes: the Regional Movers Index (developed in partnership with the Commonwealth Bank of Australia) that maps population movements; monthly Regional Labour Markets Update briefs that use ABS and Jobs and Skills Australia datasets; a Regional Migration Experience research report (08.05.2026); and the Regionalisation Ambition 2032 – Year 3 Progress Report (07.10.2025). RAI runs events and programs including the Regions Rising National Summit (14.09.2026 listed), regional “Regions Rising” events (example: Perth, WA), and a Masterclass Program “designed exclusively for CEOs and Executives.” The site also references membership options and alliance arrangements. Financial data extracted from the ACNC AIS for 01/07/2022–30/06/2023 shows revenue of AUD 6,214,413 and total expenses of AUD 5,424,456. The organisation’s descriptions of activities, partnerships and national remit are taken from its own website and regulatory filings.

data.SummaryOfActivities: The Regional Australia Institute (RAI) is the only national, independent think-tank and research organisation dedicated to building robust economies and a better quality of life in regional towns and cities across Australia. The RAI is a non-partisan, not-for-profit organisation that undertakes research to stimulate and activate our regional and rural communities.
